Name: Pierre sells Loved crops SVE
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Pierre sells Loved crops SVERequirements: Content Patcher & Stardew Valley Expanded Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu & Pierre sells Loved crops This mod adds Stardew Valley Expanded NPC's Loved crops to Pierre's store. You can choose to have the crops for sale by year or the season of the NPC's birthday. There is optional dialogue changes to Pierre. Dialogue mentions who has a birthday and their loved crops. If the NPC does not have a loved crop, Pierre will still mention them on their birthday. Claire (Fall 8) sunflower //1Lance (Spring 8) monster mushroom //2Magnus (Winter 17) purple mushroom (sold with Pierre sells loved crops)Olivia (Spring 15) no loved crop/flower Scarlett (Summer 7) cherry //3Sophia (Winter 27) fairy rose //4Victor (Summer 23) no loved crop/flower Andy (Spring 23) no loved crop/flower Apples (No BD) raisins //5Gunther (Winter 12) no loved crop/flower Martin (Summer 6) juice //6Marlon (Winter 19) no loved crop/flower Morris (Spring 2) Truffle oil //7Morgan (Fall 7) void mayonnaise //8Susan (Fall 28) no loved crop/flower

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract the Generic Mod Config Menu mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿ (optional
but recommended)
4. Download and Extract [b]Pierre sells loved crops SVE [/b]into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
5. Launch Stardew Valley. To enable the settings you want, click the cog wheel on the bottom left of the
Stardew Valley title screen.

All of my mods work together. Dialogue related to stores selling is optional.
